sloka: अहम् तव प्रियम् मन्ये रामस्य व्यसनम् महत् ।रामस्य व्यसन्म् दृष्ट्वा तेन एतानि प्रभाषसे ॥३-४५-२२॥
transliteration: aham tava priyam manye rāmasya vyasanam mahat ।rāmasya vyasanm dṛṣṭvā tena etāni prabhāṣase ॥3-45-22॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana,do you speak such words seeing the disaster of Rama? No wonder that cruel men who always move like you in disguise will thus resort to sinful action against rivals.
